Definition: an Arabian or inhabitant of Arab (i.e. Arabia)
BiblicalUsage: The Arabians appear as neighbours of Israel, sometimes bringing flocks as tribute to Jehoshaphat, sometimes standing with Sanballat and Tobiah to mock Nehemiah's wall. The word is simply an Arabian, a man of Arabia.
TheologicalSignificance: Neighbours can bring tribute one generation and mockery the next, and the wall gets built either way.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
